desc: Prove and document the corrected pairwise bad condition (same-sign strict crossing; same l or same r with different other endpoint, any sign) and the monotone suffix-min query reduction.
Parse input, compute l/r/sign for all people, and initialize nxt[i]=INF.
Compute endpoint candidates: right-to-left scan over all signs for same l or same r, setting nxt[i] to the earliest later index in that group.

Implement same-sign strict-crossing candidates via online laminar removal: per sign, maintain active unassigned intervals with a segment tree over l storing max active r and per-l Fenwick active-r sets; for each new interval, remove all active intervals crossed by it using the two innermost-containing loops and update nxt.
Combine all nxt values, build suffix minima, answer all queries, and validate with sample tests plus the built-in small brute-force/random self-test.
